text:
maria: Quick poll 30505 - thinking through weekend plans. Weather looks iffy. Choices: (1) indoor boardgame afternoon (I can host and have Catan + Wingspan), (2) lakeside stroll + coffee if it's dry, or (3) bicycle tune-up at noon then coffee. Who's in/which option?

alex: Im in for games if we go indoor. Wingspan preferred, but happy with Catan. I can bring trail mix and a travel coffee press. :coffee: :game_die:

jamie: If it rains, Ill host 55 big table + space to spread games out. @maria you cool with moving to my place?

maria: @jamie yes, thanks! Ill bring snacks and the games. Also can bring a small speaker.

noah: If it's dry I was planning to ride but Id rather not get soaked. Boardgames sound cozy. I can bring Bluetooth speaker + a playlist.

sophia: Lakeside run is tempting but not if it's drizzling. If indoors, tea for me please. :tea:

alex: Also, happy to help with bike tune-ups if anyone wants. Im no pro but can fix a noisy chain.

maria: Proposed rule: Check forecast by 10am Sunday. If chance of heavy rain >50% -> meet at Jamie's 1pm for games. Otherwise meet at north lakeside path 11am for an easy walk + coffee. I'll post final call at 10:15. :umbrella: :clock1: :maple_leaf:

devbot: Calendar event "Weekend Plans: Walk or Games" created for Sunday 13:00 at Jamie's place. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood.dev/events/2410004321

jamie: RSVP yes. I'll DM address to folks. Any dietary restrictions?

noah: No nuts please in snacks for me.

alex: No strawberries for me (allergy).

maria: Cool. I'll do nut-free cookies and bring coffee. See you Sunday! :sparkles:
